name: Largo Tank & Equipment Inc.
old_description: For over 25 years, Largo Tank & Equipment has built exceptional equipment and has been there for our customers when it counts. We are the premier manufacturing and service facility for Truck Mounted Equipment, Fire Equipment, Truck Tanks and Tank Trailers when the requirements call for absolute off-road dependability.
about:
Largo Tank & Equipment Inc. operates from Farmington, New Mexico, where it has served the Southwest for over 25 years. The company was founded as a manufacturing and service facility focused on truck-mounted equipment, fire apparatus, and tank trailers built for off-road dependability. No founders or ownership details are disclosed.

At its Farmington facility, Largo designs, welds, and assembles custom truck bodies, cargo tanks, and fire equipment. The shop produces flatbeds, welder bodies, platform and dump bodies, service bodies, oilfield and chemical treater trucks, crane bodies, contractor beds, propane service trucks, and van bodies. It also stocks thousands of hard-to-find parts and represents hundreds of brands, offering same-day shipping on stocked items and 24/7 emergency service.

The company serves oil and gas, propane, construction, fuel delivery, mining, crane service, delivery, fire and emergency, government, farm and ranch, plumbing, and landscaping sectors. Customers include municipal fleets, public works departments, wildland firefighting units, and commercial contractors operating in the San Juan Basin and surrounding regions.

Largo emphasizes custom design and close collaboration to meet unique project requirements, aiming to make customers' work easier and build equipment right every time. Its "Built Largo Tough" philosophy reflects a focus on reliability in harsh off-road conditions.
